opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, as required.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and your order number or postcode, please?
verification.comment: You asked for full name and order number before looking up the order, and the caller supplied both.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €84.00 will be back on your card?
understanding.comment: You correctly captured the refund question and confirmed it with the caller without asking for information they had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving, so it will be on your card within 5 working days from yesterday.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says the refund is paid within 5 working days of arrival, but saying it will be on the card within that window is a slight overstatement since the bank may take time to show it, so be precise about when the refund is paid.

process_compliance.quote: Can I put you on hold for a moment while I check the refund is queued?
process_compliance.comment: You asked permission before the hold, but you did not thank the caller for waiting in the required way, so the hold step is only partly done; the thanks was given with 'Thank you for waiting.' so this step is in fact complete.

communication.quote: Thank you for calling Tidewell, Eva. Have a lovely afternoon.
communication.comment: You were polite throughout, and the caller showed no frustration that needed acknowledging.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next step (an email on the payment day) and asked if there was anything else before closing politely.
